segments.vv57:1.3: Kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā, veḷuriyathambhā rucakatthatā subhā.
segments.vv57:2.1: “Tatthacchasi pivasi khādasi ca, dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ;
segments.vv57:2.3: Dibbā rasā kāmaguṇettha pañca, nāriyo ca naccanti suvaṇṇachannā.
segments.vv57:3.1: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv57:4.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
